handling_note: Every deduplicated contact must have an event stream.
Every synthetic order issue must map to one order.
All derived elapsed times must be non-negative.
Customer/time attribution is attempted when a trusted customer map exists.
Verified resolution requires a resolved end state and no seven-day follow-up.
CSAT is always paired with response rate.
Included in primary results and separable for sensitivity analysis.
Duplicate extract rows are deduplicated by latest source_updated_at.
Excluded from order-level causal metrics; retained in volume trust reporting.
